t: This is Millbank House, an office building just south of College Green in Westminster. It was originally known as numbers one and two Millbank, and it's Grade II star listed, which puts it among the more important protected buildings in the country. It was designed by the architect William Douglas Caroe, who lived from 1857 to 1938. Look at how it sits among the buildings around Parliament, and take in the detail of the architecture while you're here.
